prompt: Count islands of '1's connected horizontally or vertically in a grid.
pattern: DFS/BFS flood fill
complexity: O(R * C) time, O(R * C) space
edge_case: Empty grid; recursion depth on a huge island.

prompt: Decide if all courses can be finished given prerequisite pairs.
pattern: Cycle detection (Kahn or 3-colour DFS)
complexity: O(V + E) time, O(V + E) space
edge_case: Self-dependency; disconnected components.

prompt: Return minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if impossible.
pattern: Multi-source BFS
complexity: O(R * C) time, O(R * C) space
edge_case: No fresh oranges at all returns 0.

prompt: Given an n x n matrix of direct connections between cities, count the groups of connected cities.
pattern: Union-find (or DFS) over the adjacency matrix
edge_case: Diagonal self-connections; an isolated city is its own province.

prompt: Return an order in which to take all courses, or empty if impossible.
pattern: Topological sort (Kahn's algorithm)
complexity: O(V + E) time, O(V + E) space
edge_case: Cycle detection: output shorter than V.

prompt: Find the shortest transformation length from begin to end word, changing one letter at a time via a word list.
pattern: BFS over wildcard pattern buckets
complexity: O(N * L^2) time, O(N * L^2) space
edge_case: End word missing from the list.

prompt: Given words sorted in an unknown alphabet, derive a valid order of its letters.
pattern: Build edges from adjacent words, topological sort
edge_case: Prefix case like ['abc', 'ab'] is invalid.

prompt: Find the lowest common ancestor of two nodes in a binary tree.
pattern: Post-order: return the node found in each subtree
edge_case: One node is an ancestor of the other.

prompt: Decide whether a binary tree is a valid binary search tree.
pattern: DFS with (low, high) bounds or in-order
edge_case: Duplicates; values at integer limits.

prompt: Return the values visible when looking at a binary tree from the right side.
pattern: BFS level order, take the last node per level
edge_case: Left subtree deeper than the right one.

prompt: Return the k-th smallest value in a binary search tree.
pattern: In-order traversal with counter
edge_case: k equal to the number of nodes.

prompt: Return the length of the longest path between any two nodes in a binary tree.
pattern: DFS height, update global left + right
edge_case: Path need not pass through the root.

prompt: Implement insert, search and startsWith for a prefix tree.
pattern: Trie nodes with children map + end flag
complexity: O(L) per op time, O(total chars) space
edge_case: Prefix that is also a full word.

prompt: Return the level-order values of a binary tree, alternating left-to-right and right-to-left on each level.
pattern: BFS by level, reverse every other level (or fill a deque from alternating ends)
edge_case: Empty tree returns []; do not reverse the BFS queue itself, only the level output.

prompt: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list.
pattern: Min-heap of list heads
complexity: O(N log K) time, O(K) space
edge_case: Some lists empty; k == 0.

prompt: Return the k most frequent elements.
pattern: Count + size-K min-heap (or bucket sort)
complexity: O(N log K) time, O(N) space
edge_case: Ties in frequency; k equal to the number of distinct values.

prompt: Return the k-th largest element in an unsorted array.
pattern: Size-K min-heap or quickselect
complexity: O(N log K) time, O(K) space
edge_case: Duplicates count separately.

prompt: A car with a fixed capacity only drives east. Given trips [passengers, from, to], decide if it can complete every trip without exceeding capacity.
pattern: Sort by pickup + min-heap of drop-offs (or difference array)
complexity: O(N log N) time, O(N) space
edge_case: Drop-offs at a location happen before pick-ups at the same location.

prompt: Design a structure that supports adding numbers and returning the running median.
pattern: Two heaps: max-heap low half, min-heap high half
complexity: O(log N) add, O(1) median time, O(N) space
edge_case: Even count returns the average of the two middles.

prompt: Find the minimum time units to run tasks when identical tasks need n idle units between them.
pattern: Greedy by max frequency (formula or heap)
edge_case: n == 0; several tasks share the max frequency.

prompt: Rearrange a string so no two adjacent characters are equal, or return empty if impossible.
pattern: Max-heap, place most frequent char not equal to last
complexity: O(N log A) time, O(A) space
edge_case: Impossible when maxFreq > (n + 1) / 2.

prompt: Merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping result.
pattern: Sort by start, merge overlaps
complexity: O(N log N) time, O(N) space
edge_case: Touching intervals like [1,4] and [4,5] should merge.

prompt: Insert a new interval into a sorted list of non-overlapping intervals, merging if needed.
pattern: Three-phase scan: before, overlap, after
edge_case: New interval before all or after all existing intervals.

prompt: Given meeting time intervals, find the minimum number of conference rooms required.
pattern: Min-heap of end times or sweep line
complexity: O(N log N) time, O(N) space
edge_case: A meeting ending exactly when another starts frees the room.

prompt: Balloons span [x_start, x_end] on the x-axis. An arrow shot at x bursts every balloon covering x. Find the fewest arrows that burst them all.
pattern: Greedy: sort by end, shoot at the earliest end, skip balloons it bursts
complexity: O(N log N) time, O(1) space
edge_case: Touching balloons like [1,2] and [2,3] share one arrow; avoid a - b comparators that overflow.

prompt: Remove every interval that is covered by another interval and return how many remain.
pattern: Sort by start ascending and end descending; count intervals that extend the max end
complexity: O(N log N) time, O(1) space
edge_case: Equal starts: the longer interval must come first or it will be counted twice.

prompt: Find the minimum number of intervals to remove so the rest do not overlap.
pattern: Greedy: sort by end, keep earliest finishing
complexity: O(N log N) time, O(1) space
edge_case: Touching endpoints are not overlapping.

prompt: Given each employee's sorted working intervals, return the finite common free time slots.
pattern: Merge sorted interval lists with a heap
complexity: O(N log K) time, O(K) space
edge_case: Ignore infinite gaps before the first and after the last interval.

prompt: Maximise money robbed from houses in a line without robbing two adjacent houses.
pattern: 1D DP: rob or skip
edge_case: Single house.

prompt: Count the paths from top-left to bottom-right moving only right or down.
pattern: Grid DP (or combinatorics)
edge_case: 1 x N grid has exactly one path.

prompt: Count how many ways a digit string can be decoded where 'A'=1 ... 'Z'=26.
pattern: 1D DP with one- and two-digit lookback
edge_case: Zeros: '0', '06', '100' have no valid decoding.

prompt: Decide if a string can be split into a sequence of dictionary words.
pattern: DP over prefixes with a word set
edge_case: Reusing words is allowed.

prompt: Return the longest substring of s that reads the same forwards and backwards.
pattern: Expand around each of the 2N - 1 centres (interval DP also works)
edge_case: Even-length palindromes need a centre between two characters.

prompt: Decide whether an array can be split into two subsets with equal sums.
pattern: 0/1 knapsack over reachable sums (loop sums downwards)
edge_case: An odd total is impossible; iterate sums from high to low so each number is used once.

prompt: For each day, return how many days you must wait until a warmer temperature (0 if never).
pattern: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices
edge_case: Equal temperatures do not count as warmer.

prompt: For each element of a circular array, return the next greater element, or -1.
pattern: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices over two passes (circular)
edge_case: All-equal values return -1 everywhere; only push indices in the first pass.

prompt: Remove k digits from a number string to make the smallest possible number.
pattern: Monotonic increasing stack of digits: pop while the top is bigger
edge_case: Strip leading zeros, return '0' when empty, and drop from the end if k is left over.

prompt: Given bar heights of a histogram, find the area of the largest rectangle.
pattern: Monotonic increasing stack with sentinel
edge_case: All equal heights; strictly increasing heights (flush the stack at the end).

prompt: Return the maximum of every contiguous window of size k.
pattern: Monotonic deque of indices
edge_case: k == 1 and k == n; evict indices that fall out of the window.

prompt: Compute how much rain water is trapped between bars of given heights.
pattern: Monotonic decreasing stack of bars (or two pointers with running max)
edge_case: Fewer than 3 bars traps nothing.

pattern: Missing the stale-entry skip: add 'if d > dist[u]: continue'. Still correct but can blow up to O(E^2) work on dense graphs.
complexity: O(E log V) time, O(V + E) space
edge_case: Many duplicate heap entries for the same node.

pattern: Marking visited on pop lets the same cell be enqueued many times. Mark visited when you push.
complexity: O(R * C) time, O(R * C) space
edge_case: Open grid with no walls explodes the queue.

pattern: Only checks parent-child pairs. A grandchild can violate the BST. Pass (low, high) bounds down.
edge_case: Tree [5,4,6,null,null,3,7] must be invalid.

prompt:
Trie search:

  def search(self, word):
      node = self.root
      for ch in word:
          if ch not in node.children: return False
          node = node.children[ch]
      return True
pattern: Returns True for any prefix. The last line must be `return node.end`.
edge_case: After insert("apple"), search("app") must be False.

pattern: heap[-1] is not the minimum. The k-th largest is heap[0] (root of the min-heap).
complexity: O(N log K) time, O(K) space
edge_case: k == len(nums).

prompt:
Merge k sorted lists:

  heap = [(l.val, l) for l in lists if l]
  heapq.heapify(heap)
  while heap:
      val, node = heapq.heappop(heap)
      tail.next = node; tail = node
      if node.next: heapq.heappush(heap, (node.next.val, node.next))
pattern: Equal values make heapq compare ListNode objects -> TypeError. Push (val, unique_counter, node).
complexity: O(N log K) time, O(K) space
edge_case: Two lists that start with the same value.

pattern: Merged end must be max(out[-1][1], e); [1,10] then [2,3] would shrink to [1,3]. Also empty input crashes.
complexity: O(N log N) time, O(N) space
edge_case: Nested interval fully inside another.

pattern: Missing the guard c <= a (negative index wraps around in Python) and returning inf instead of -1.
edge_case: Unreachable amount must return -1.

pattern: Ascending loop reuses x many times (unbounded knapsack). Loop s from target down to x.
edge_case: nums = [1, 2, 5] (target 4) must be False.

pattern: Never evicts indices that left the window. Add `if dq[0] <= i - k: dq.popleft()` before reading dq[0].
